OpcodeCore.doc: Foundational VDBE opcode family: program termination, constant load, register moves/copies, cursor lifecycle, row emission.

LoadConst.doc: Copy the embedded constant into dest_reg. The constant carries an owned payload for Text/Blob cases (cloned into the register).

Move.doc: Move the value from src_reg to dest_reg. After execution src_reg holds Value::Null. If src == dest, the register becomes Null (net effect of take-then-set on the same slot).

Copy.doc: Clone the value from src_reg into dest_reg. src_reg is unchanged. If src == dest, no-op (skip clone).

OpenRead.doc: Ask storage to open a read-only cursor on `table`; on success install at cursor slot. TableNotFound -> Halt(Error). If slot was occupied: replace silently (compiler is responsible for Close first when needed).

OpenWrite.doc: Same as OpenRead but opens a writable cursor.

Close.doc: Release the cursor handle at `cursor`. No-op if already empty (idempotent).

ResultRow.doc: Signal the outer loop to emit a row from registers [start_reg .. start_reg+count). count == 0 is ill-formed -> Halt(Error(OpcodeIllegal)).

execute.doc: Execute one core opcode against the state. Per-opcode semantics in master.md. Outer loop interprets the returned outcome.
